what_exists.plant: A runnable coupled6 production plant exists, with parametric-hull Capytaine hydrodynamics, empirical viscous damping, hydrostatics, and two rate-limited azimuth thrusters.
what_exists.allocation: The integrated allocation/composability campaign passes finite-output, thrust-limit, angle-continuity, failure-mode, and checkpoint-replay checks. It deliberately includes rank-deficient and infeasible geometries as diagnostics.
what_exists.external_campaign: AERO4River has three checksum-locked applied-wrench replays through the actual unconstrained Vehicle C coupled6 plant; all are deterministic and numerically stable.

available_external_target.name: AERO4River v1
available_external_target.configuration: 20.8 kg vessel with four aerial azimuth thrusters
available_external_target.compatibility: not a dual-water-azimuth Vehicle C match
available_external_target.result: descriptive only; position RMSE is 9.43-11.40 m, yaw RMSE is 1.21-1.75 rad, and no post-hoc tolerance is valid

reference_target_assessment.conclusion: There is no defensible reference dataset that can currently validate Vehicle C behavioral dynamics or dual-water-azimuth propulsion.

allocation_risk_assessment.what_is_covered: Static/step allocation behavior, singular and near-singular geometry, failed-off/stuck modes, thrust limits, and azimuth state continuity.
allocation_risk_assessment.what_is_missing: A dynamic reachable-wrench-envelope campaign that records desired wrench, allocated commands, actual azimuth/thrust states, residual wrench, saturation, and slew-limit occupancy during representative transients. Current least-squares allocation computes commands against the current azimuth state and does not plan over future azimuth slew.
allocation_risk_assessment.disposition: Treat this as a proactive software verification gap, not a demonstrated source of behavioral mismatch. It cannot substitute for physical validation data.

what_validation_requires: Independent Vehicle C or geometrically and propulsively matched dual-water-azimuth command, actuator, and trajectory measurements.
A preregistered maneuver set (straight-line, turning circles, 10/10 and 20/20 zig-zags, acceleration/coast-down, and low-speed station-keeping) with fixed channel-wise tolerances.
Measured thrust/azimuth channels or calibrated actuator maps, plus hull geometry, mass/inertia, and free-decay or captive-test data sufficient to identify damping and maneuvering terms.
A dynamic allocation-envelope audit before controller-transfer claims.

effort_assessment.reason: Vehicle B has six measured MARIN trajectories for model-structure diagnostics, while Vehicle C has no same-configuration reference target and requires new reference acquisition or a newly justified surrogate-validation protocol before a physical claim is possible.
effort_assessment.figure_6_readiness: The A/B/C topology contrast is real (A differential thrust, B propeller/rudder, C dual azimuth), but Vehicle C should not be presented as behaviorally validated in a heterogeneous-transfer matrix until the missing evidence is obtained.

next_review_decision: Decide whether Figure 6 may use Vehicle C only as allocation/composability and simulator-transfer evidence, or whether to defer it pending matched validation data. Do not start a parameter-tuning build from the AERO4River mismatch.
